about_the_game:
Experience the [B]irth of a brand-ne[W] world of [S]ound

A highly anticipated arrangement album featuring reimagined music from NieR:Automata!

Under the supervision of composer Keiichi Okabe, a lineup of talented arrangers brings fresh new interpretations to the game’s beloved tracks, offering a unique and diverse take on NieR:Automata's iconic sound.

Additionally, the album includes unreleased tracks that were not featured in the original soundtrack.

Experience NieR:Automata’s music from an entirely new perspective!
